data.gender_notes: Fahriyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'Fahar', which means 'to be fragrant', 'to give off a pleasant smell'. The name Fahriyah is a feminine form of this root word, meaning 'fragrant, sweet-smelling'. The name Fahriyah carries the meaning “Fragrant, Sweet-Smelling” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fahriyah usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant, sweet-smelling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fahriyah is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of gentleness, fragility, and grace. It is a reminder of the delicate beauty of creation and the importance of treating all beings with kindness and compassion.
data.etymology: Fahriyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant, Sweet-Smelling.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fahriyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
